message:
You know those moments when you’re all cozy at home, and the weather starts acting a bit too dramatic? 🌪️ I had one of those last week when the sky turned shades I didn’t know existed. Naturally, I rummaged through my emergency kit, feeling pretty smug about my preparedness. 

Turns out, having a plan and some supplies can really help you ride out the storm without turning into a human stress ball. 

It’s a good reminder that it’s never too late to gather a few essentials and feel a bit more in control. What’s your favorite tip for staying calm when the weather gets wild?
